SELECT count(0)
FROM WARN_RULE_TOTAL WRT
	INNER JOIN EMP_MSG_RMNDR_RULE ER ON ER.STATUS = ?
	AND ER.EMP_ID = WRT.EMP_ID
	AND EXISTS (
		SELECT ?
		FROM SYS_USER_QW SUQ
		WHERE ER.EMP_ID = SUQ.USER_ID
	)
	AND ER.EVENT_TP = WRT.WARN_SUB_CD 
WHERE (WRT.WARN_SUB_CD = ?)
	AND WRT.WARN_ACCT_TYPE = ?
	AND WRT.CUST_NO IS NOT NULL
	AND WRT.CUST_NM IS NOT NULL
	AND nvl(WRT.is_read, ?) = ?
	AND nvl(WRT.we_send_flg, ?) = ?
